featured_reviews.name: Vali C
featured_reviews.review_text:
Update: Had been following up with the hospital for a deposit refund. They'd said 2 months. I waited 3 months and a week more because they had banking issues. Every time I called (after the 2-month mark) the staff promised to call back with updates in a few days or a week, but no one called and I had to reach out myself. I even called my medical insurance provider on 30-April to assist the hospital when they said they hadn't got the insurance money, and that's actually how they discovered that their bank account had an issue (the staff did not know, at all). The hospital staff promised to call me back on 04-May but didn't. When they didn't answer my call on 09-May, I finally had enough and went to the hospital in-person to ask for a refund. I was told they couldn't provide it because they hadn't got the money from the insurance company. I told them I'm not at fault for their banking issues and that I wouldn't be here if they'd called back with an update. The staff told me they can't do anything and I said I will wait in the reception area until I get my refund or I talk to their owner. After waiting for an hour or so, I got my refund.
At this point, I'd like to clarify that I didn't mention the other issues we'd had during our hospitalization on 30-Jan and 31-Jan, mainly because the staff was polite even when I was upset about these issues (mentioned in 31-Jan review below). My wife was admitted to the ICU because of a cardiac emergency.
Issue#1) When I visited her in the ICU, there was no doctor inside, only a nurse. The nurse informed me that there's only one attending doctor on the floor and he was busy with dressing a patient outside the ICU.
Issue#2) There was a power outage in the area and the entire hospital, including the ICU, lost power (see attached video). I asked the staff whether the ICU has a power backup and they said the oxygen is on but there is no electricity backup. All the monitoring machines in the ICU were down. And the heat was as bad in the ICU as it was in the corridor.

Old review, 31 Jan 2026 (4-stars): The staff is polite and responsive. Mr.Tausif, Ms.Vaishali, and Ms.Angelina were very helpful and helped calm a tense situation. It's a good place in Jogeshwari West.

featured_reviews.name: uzma khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Best Hospital Staff and Excellent Services!

I had a wonderful experience at this hospital. A big thanks to Dr. Zayan Sayyed for handling my normal delivery so smoothly. Throughout my nine-month pregnancy, I was under the care of Dr. Seemi Siddiqui, who guided me very well. However, during the last month, she informed me that my chances of normal delivery were very low and advised me to be prepared for a C-section. My entire family and I were quite tense because all my reports were normal and I had no complications — and it being my first child, we were really hoping for a normal delivery.

When my due date passed without any pain, I got admitted as advised by Dr. Seemi Siddiqui. Coincidentally, she went on leave that very day and handed over my case to Dr. Zayan Sayyed. With her experience, confidence, and expertise, Dr. Zayan guided us perfectly and successfully conducted my normal and safe delivery. I’m truly grateful to her and her entire team for their support and care.

I would also like to thank Dr. Seemi Siddiqui and her team for being with me throughout my pregnancy journey.

The hospital is extremely well-equipped with all necessary facilities for new moms and babies — including NICU and expert pediatricians, making it a one-stop destination for all maternity needs. Cleanliness, security, and overall service are truly commendable — a full 10/10 experience.

Highly recommended to all expecting mothers!

My experience at the colonoscopy department was extremely disappointing and stressful. The staff behavior was rude, unprofessional, and insensitive towards patients.
Instead of properly guiding patients, the staff misguides them, gives unclear or contradictory instructions, and unnecessarily delays the process. Patients are made to wait for long hours without valid explanation, resulting in wastage of valuable time, which is unacceptable—especially for patients who are already anxious or unwell.

I would not recommend this department unless major improvements are made.
